title: SYJ V2 Transaction Compatibility Schema
description: Compatibility schema for the implemented Phase 8.1 V2 normal transaction envelope. The canonical protocol network identifier is network_id. Production fee/expiry extensions require a separately versioned protocol decision.

version.description: Implemented V2 transaction version. A different version requires a separately versioned contract.

network_id.description: Canonical SYJ network identity: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. It MUST equal the active network identity.

sender.description: SYJ sender address; cryptographic address validation is performed by protocol code.

receiver.description: SYJ receiver address; cryptographic address validation is performed by protocol code.

amount_base_units.description: Positive unsigned base-unit amount; the current implementation bounds it by the protocol maximum-supply constant.

timestamp.description: Finite non-negative timestamp under current implementation rules; non-finite JSON numeric values are rejected by protocol validation.

sender_public_key.description: Raw 64-byte secp256k1 public key encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.

signature.description: Raw R||S signature encoded as lowercase hexadecimal.

$comment: network_id is canonical. A Cosmos/CometBFT chain-id is an external compatibility representation only and is not a transaction field. Production fee/expiry fields remain TBD — requires governance, economic, and security review.
